transcript: Welcome back to Meta Ads Must-Haves Episode 4, where in this series I am teaching you everything that you need to know about Meta Ads that you can become a Meta Ads manager and make a fuck ton of money and work a fraction of the time. In today's episode, we are going to be talking about budgeting, because there's two decisions that you have to make when it comes to budgeting. First decision is do you want to do a daily versus a lifetime budget. Daily means hey Meta, you have X amount of money that I would like for you to spend every single day indefinitely until I tell you otherwise. And lifetime budget means hey, you have this lump sum amount of money that I need you to spend between X and Y dates. And once the money has been spent or that last date has passed, then you turn off the campaign. Generally I recommend everyone do daily budgeting because you can really manually control your budget a lot easier and extend the life of a campaign for as long as you need to. Then the second decision that you have to make is where do you want to determine your budget. In a previous episode, I mentioned that it could either be at the campaign level or the ad set level. At the campaign level, you're just saying hey Meta, you have X amount of money that I want you to spend every single day divided amongst my ad sets as you see fit to get me the best return on my ad spend. Whereas maybe you actually need to test some different elements within your ad. So you need to limit your spend variable and have every single ad set spend the same amount. In that case, you're going to do an ad set budget optimization and say hey, I want $30 for this ad set every day 30 for this one and 30 for this one. And that is essentially the gist of determining your budget. So many of you have been enjoying this series and actually been requesting a course. So I am working on a meta ads crash course where it's going to be a beginner friendly meta ads course. And while I work on building this, I've actually opened up my waitlist. So if you join my waitlist, you get early access discounted pricing and I'll share some bonus content.
